events.title: Illinois Becomes the 21st U.S. State
events.description: Illinois was admitted to the Union as the 21st state. It had grown from a frontier territory along the Mississippi and Ohio rivers.
events.significance: Illinois grew into a major center of agriculture, transport and industry in the American Midwest. It later produced leaders such as Abraham Lincoln.

events.title: Robert Louis Stevenson Dies in Samoa
events.description: The Scottish author of Treasure Island and Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde died of a stroke at his home in Vailima, Samoa. He was 44. He had settled in the South Pacific in search of a healthier climate.
events.significance: Stevenson's adventure stories and psychological tales are still widely read and adapted. His unfinished novel Weir of Hermiston was published after his death.

events.title: Neon Lighting Makes Its Public Debut
events.description: French engineer Georges Claude showed neon lighting to the public at the Paris Motor Show. Glowing tubes of gas lit up the exhibition.
events.significance: Neon lighting went on to shape the look of advertising and city nightlife around the world, from Parisian boulevards to the Las Vegas Strip.

events.title: First Human Heart Transplant
events.description: At Groote Schuur Hospital in Cape Town, South African surgeon Christiaan Barnard led a team that replaced the failing heart of grocer Louis Washkansky with one from a young accident victim.
events.significance: The operation showed that transplanting a human heart was possible. It opened the way to modern transplant surgery, which now saves many lives each year.

events.title: Bhopal Gas Disaster
events.description: A toxic gas leak at a Union Carbide pesticide plant in Bhopal, India, exposed hundreds of thousands of people to poisonous fumes. The leak began overnight and the worst of its impact was felt on December 3.
events.significance: It is regarded as one of the worst industrial disasters in history. It led to lasting health problems for survivors and prompted stronger safety and accountability standards for hazardous industries.
